changelog:
Initial release of the find-marketing-agency skill.

- Enables users to find, shortlist, vet, and enrich US marketing agencies across various categories (branding, PPC, content, social, email, video, digital, etc.).
- Utilizes the ServiceGraph API to filter a 100K+ firm catalog by service, location, industry, size, ratings, and more.
- Excludes SEO-only, web/software development, in-house recruiting, marketing plan writing, non-US, freelancer, software product, and personal brand asks.
- Provides DSL filter examples and guidance, with API usage details, cost model, and authentication flow.
- Automatically identifies and pins the correct firm category (industry:marketing_agency) for all operations.
